identity_evidence.verdict: Scuttlebug is COINED. The cartridge's class name is daSpd_c. Under the current rule a coined name is allowed, but it must be recorded as coined and never presented as ROM-proven -- this field is that record.
identity_evidence.rom_string: extracted/overlays/overlay_0071.bin, file offset 0x3bf0 -> address 0x02122bf0, bytes 37 64 61 53 70 64 5f 63 00 = "7daSpd_c\0". That is the Itanium length-prefixed _ZTS form: length 7, then the 7 characters d a S p d _ c.
identity_evidence.negative_search: A byte search of every extracted image (extracted/arm9.bin, extracted/arm9_dec.bin, extracted/arm7.bin and all extracted/overlays/*.bin) for the length-prefixed form b'10Scuttlebug\0' returns 0 hits, and for the raw substring b'Scuttlebug' also 0 hits. The string 'Spider' -- the sense of Spd, and the spelling the project's g_profile_SPIDER uses -- returns 0 hits as well. Nothing named Scuttlebug or Spider exists anywhere in this cartridge.
identity_evidence.whole_overlay_string_census: ov071 contains exactly five printable runs of >=5 characters in its entire 0x3f80 bytes: 7daSpd_c (0x02122bf0), 8daEykn_c (0x02122cd8), 8daEyBm_c (0x02122dac), STANDUP (0x02122e6c) and 13daObjCasket_c (0x02122ea0). Four of the five are _ZTS records; there is no room for a hidden English name.
identity_evidence.tooling_corroboration: tools/rtti_extract.py builds build/rtti.json from the ROM (429 records, 0 unresolved). Its record for this class is {module: ov071, addr: 0x02122bfc, kind: si, mangled: 7daSpd_c, name: daSpd_c, name_addr: 0x02122bf0, vtable: 0x02122c2c}. `tools/rtti_vtables.py --own daSpd_c` prints the full override set; `--own Scuttlebug` prints 'no vtable for Scuttlebug' -- the ROM-derived database has never heard the name.
identity_evidence.symbols_txt_asymmetry: config/arm9/overlays/ov071/symbols.txt aliases the VTABLE under both spellings at one address (_ZTV10Scuttlebug and _ZTV7daSpd_c, both addr:0x02122c2c) but names _ZTS/_ZTI under the daSpd_c spelling only. So a TU compiled as `class Scuttlebug` emits _ZTS10Scuttlebug (13 bytes) and _ZTI10Scuttlebug, neither of which has any home in the cartridge. That is survivable on the queue's declared text-only route, where the RTTI data is externalized/deadstripped, and FATAL to an intact-object route. Do not attempt intact-object under the coined spelling.
identity_evidence.sibling_naming_pattern: Three of ov071's four classes carry coined tree names and one does not: Scuttlebug=daSpd_c (coined), MrI=daEykn_c (coined; symbols.txt aliases _ZTV3MrI and _ZTV8daEykn_c at 0x02122d30), Coffin=daObjCasket_c (coined), daEyBm_c=daEyBm_c (the ROM name, and the one class already promoted).

module_base_derivation: extracted/dsd/arm9_overlays/overlays.yaml, entry id:71 -> base_address 34009088 = 0x0211f000, code_size 0x3f80, bss_size 0x180. Two independent checks: (a) extracted/overlays/overlay_0071.bin is exactly 16256 = 0x3f80 bytes, equal to code_size, so file offset 0 IS address 0x0211f000 and address = 0x0211f000 + file_offset with no adjustment; (b) the lowest symbol in config/arm9/overlays/ov071/symbols.txt is _ZN10ScuttlebugD1Ev addr:0x0211f000, and the bytes at file offset 0x0211f000-0x0211f000 = 0 are e92d4010 = `push {r4, lr}` -- a function prologue, not data. Every RTTI read below was taken at address minus 0x0211f000. NOTE: ov070, ov071 and ov072 all load at 0x0211f000; they are mutually exclusive overlays sharing one address window, which is why every relocation scan below is filtered on the destination MODULE and not on the address.

text_run.contiguity: 37 consecutive delinks entries with zero gaps -- each entry's end is the next entry's start. The run starts at the first byte of ov071's .text and ends immediately before _ZN3MrID1Ev at 0x02120668.

shard_count_correction.why: The 37th shard is src/d_a_spd.c, holding daSpd_c_classInit at 0x02120618 (size 0x50). tools/tu_map.py cuts on symbol NAME, and daSpd_c_classInit is spelt neither _ZN10Scuttlebug... nor func_ov071_..., so it was never labelled and never counted -- even though _ZN10Scuttlebug13OnTurnIntoEggER6Player ends at exactly 0x02120580 + 0x98 = 0x02120618, a ZERO-byte gap. ov071 puts each class's factory last in its own run; the promoted sibling daEyBm_c carries daEyBm_c_classInit the same way.
shard_count_correction.consequence: A promotion that folds only the 36 name-matched shards leaves a one-function hole inside a contiguous run and cannot produce a single `complete` span. Fold all 37.

size_evidence: daSpd_c_classInit at 0x02120618 opens `push {r4,lr}` / `mov r0,#0x3ac` / `bl 0x02043444`, and 0x02043444 is _ZN7fBase_cnwEj (fBase_c::operator new(unsigned)) in config/arm9/symbols.txt. 0x3ac = 940. The trailing fields close exactly on it: a halfword at 0x3a8 and a byte at 0x3aa, then one pad byte.

fields_method: This-relative accesses were collected by decoding all 37 functions with capstone, seeding the this-register set with r0 at entry, propagating through `mov`, and recording every `[thisreg,#imm]` load/store plus every `add rD,thisreg,#imm`. That is a heuristic for the register set, so a single-function offset is weaker evidence than a multi-function one; each offset above carries its witness count. The four member subobjects and the state pointer are proven independently and do not rest on the heuristic.

state_machine.summary: This class runs a 9-state machine whose states are PAIRS of pointer-to-member-function records. It is the most important structural fact for the writer, and the tree's header does not model it at all.

table_data_records.shape: 18 consecutive 8-byte Itanium PMF records {fn ptr; ptrdiff_t adj;}. Every ptr word is relocated (config/arm9/overlays/ov071/relocs.txt, from:0x02122b60 through from:0x02122be8, all module:overlay(71)) to a function inside this class's own 0x0211f000..0x02120668 run, and every adj word is 0, so all 18 targets are non-virtual members. The band ends exactly where _ZTS7daSpd_c begins at 0x02122bf0.

table_runtime_array.proof: Scuttlebug_SetState's literal pool word at 0x02120300 is 0x02122fa8, and it computes `add r1,r2,r1,lsl #4` -- a 16-byte stride, i.e. two 8-byte PMFs per state. The next .bss symbol in ov071/symbols.txt is data_ov071_02123038, and 0x02123038 - 0x02122fa8 = 0x90 = 9 x 16 exactly. The 9-state count therefore falls out of the .bss extent and the .data record count independently of each other.
table_runtime_array.filled_by: __sinit_ov071_021226ac (.init 0x021226ac..0x021228c8). Its literal pool at 0x0212287c..0x021228c4 holds all 18 .data record addresses plus 0x02122fa8, the array base.

setter.body: ldr r2,[pc,#0xc] (=0x02122fa8) ; ldr ip,[pc,#0xc] (=0x021202b4) ; add r1,r2,r1,lsl #4 ; str r1,[r0,#0x380] ; bx ip
setter.meaning: SetState(this, index) stores &stateTable[index] at this+0x380 and TAIL-CALLS the on-enter dispatcher. It has 13 distinct callers inside the run -- the most-called function in the class.

dispatchers.role: invokes the CURRENT state's on-enter PMF (entry offset +0)
dispatchers.callers: none by BL -- Scuttlebug_SetState reaches it by `bx ip` through the literal at 0x02120304. A BL-only caller scan reports it as an orphan; it is not.

dispatchers.role: invokes the CURRENT state's per-frame PMF (entry offset +8: `ldr r1,[r0,#0x380] ; add r3,r1,#8`)

state_machine.pmf_call_sequence: Both dispatchers use the standard Itanium ARM PMF sequence: load adj from [entry,#4], `add this,this,adj asr #1`, `ands #1` to test the virtual bit, then either an indirect vtable load or a direct pointer, then `blx`. All 18 adj words are 0, so the virtual path is never taken by this class's own table.
state_machine.writer_hazard: These 18 records are pointer-to-member records in UNOWNED .data, and dsd resolves them by symbol NAME. The moment stage 3b renames a state handler from func_ov071_XXXXXXXX to _ZN10Scuttlebug...Ev, the new mangled name must reach config/arm9/overlays/ov071/symbols.txt IN THE SAME COMMIT, or that record links as 0x00000000. No byte gate at stage 2 or 3 catches it.

state_handlers_are_the_other_18: The remaining 18 functions (0x0211f694, 0x0211f6f8, 0x0211f7d4, 0x0211f8d0, 0x0211fa54, 0x0211fb0c, 0x0211fb24, 0x0211fbf4, 0x0211fc60, 0x0211fcd4, 0x0211fd58, 0x0211fe38, 0x0211fee4, 0x0211ff84, 0x02120028, 0x02120130, 0x021201b4, 0x02120200) have ZERO BL callers anywhere in ov071. They are reached exclusively through the PMF table above. A BL-only call scan makes every one of them look dead.

callers.inbound_cross_module: NONE. config/arm9/relocs.txt contains 13891 rows, 251 of which name some overlay, and 0 of which name overlay(70), overlay(71) or overlay(72) -- so the filter pattern is demonstrably live and the zero is a real zero, not the ov006-vs-overlay(6) spelling trap. No other overlay's relocs.txt mentions overlay(71) either; only ov071's own does.
callers.how_the_class_is_reached: Through g_profile_SPIDER at 0x02122c08, whose first word is relocated to 0x02120618 = daSpd_c_classInit (relocs.txt from:0x02122c08 -> 0x02120618 module:overlay(71)). The profile is registered by the overlay's own static initialisers at load time; nothing in arm9 points into ov071 directly.
callers.intra_overlay: A relocation scan cannot see intra-overlay BLs at all, so the whole 0x0211f000..0x021226a0 .text was decoded and every `bl` (cond AL, opcode 0xeb) resolved. Result: zero BLs cross the 0x02120668 run boundary in either direction -- nothing outside the run calls into it, and nothing inside the run calls out to another ov071 class's function. The run is call-closed.

data_and_bss_band.note: The queue's promotion_route for this row is text-only, so none of this is owned by the promoted TU. It is recorded so the writer need not rediscover the boundary, and so nobody mistakes an unowned neighbour for part of the class.

sibling_oracle_daEyBm_c.verdict: SIBLING. Not a base, not unrelated. Safe to copy from.
sibling_oracle_daEyBm_c.relationship_evidence: _ZTI8daEyBm_c sits at 0x02122db8 in ov071 and is a __si_class_type_info whose +8 word is 0x0208e390 = _ZTI8dActor_c -- the SAME direct base as this class. Bytes read from extracted/overlays/overlay_0071.bin at file offsets 0x3db8/0x3dc0; _ZTS8daEyBm_c is the length-prefixed string "8daEyBm_c\0" at 0x02122dac (file offset 0x3dac), found exactly once in the whole ROM.
sibling_oracle_daEyBm_c.structural_agreement: _ZTV8daEyBm_c has its address point at 0x02122de8 and runs to 0x02122e64 = 0x7c = 31 slots, identical in length to this class's table and to _ZTV8dActor_c. Its overrides sit on slots 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 17, 18 -- a strict subset of this class's ten, which add slots 19 and 29. Same base, same table length, same override style, same overlay, and its .data band is laid out in the same order (records -> _ZTS -> _ZTI -> g_profile_* -> _ZTV).
sibling_oracle_daEyBm_c.promotion_state: PROMOTED on origin/main b4eee7425. config/tu_manifest.d/ov071/daEyBm_c.json is status:promoted, 13 functions, promoted_source src/game/actors/d_a_ey_bm.cpp; include/daEyBm_c.h exists. Its manifest's 10-row compiler_only_output list is the closest available template for this class's.
sibling_oracle_daEyBm_c.naming_difference_to_watch: daEyBm_c kept its ROM name, so its manifest can and does claim _ZTS8daEyBm_c and _ZTI8daEyBm_c at real ov071 canonical addresses. This class CANNOT do that under the coined spelling -- see identity_evidence.symbols_txt_asymmetry. Copy daEyBm_c's structure, not its RTTI-ownership claims.

header_divergences_to_fix: include/Scuttlebug.h declares `u8 pad_0d0[0x4]`, but 0x0d0 is a live 4-byte field written by InitResources and read/written by three more functions.

include/Scuttlebug.h declares `u8 pad_350[0x58]` covering 0x350..0x3a8, but thirteen live offsets sit inside it (0x350, 0x374, 0x378, 0x37c, 0x380, 0x384, 0x388, 0x38c, 0x390, 0x394, 0x398, 0x39c, 0x3a0), including the state pointer at 0x380.

include/Scuttlebug.h declares `u8 mTimer; u8 pad_3a9[0x3];` at 0x3a8, but the ROM passes &this[0x3a8] to DecIfAbove0_Short (a short*), so 0x3a8 is a halfword, and 0x3aa is a separate live u8 with its own ldrb/strb sites.
The header models no state machine at all.
unproven: The English names of all 29 auto-named func_ov071_* handlers and helpers. Their class ownership, bodies, call graph, PMF-table positions and ordering are proven; their names are not.
The original spellings of daSpd_c_classInit (historical project alias Scuttlebug_Spawn) and Scuttlebug_SetState.
The parameter type in _ZN10Scuttlebug13OnTurnIntoEggER6Player: R6Player asserts a reference and the bytes cannot distinguish a reference from a pointer.
The return type of OnAimedAtWithEgg. 0x32000 = 50 << 12 smells like Fix12(50), but the ROM proves only the 32-bit constant.
The types and names of every field marked name_status:unproven above -- 0x0d0, 0x350, 0x374, 0x378, 0x37c, 0x384, 0x388, 0x38c, 0x390, 0x394, 0x398, 0x39c, 0x3a0, 0x3aa.
What mTimer expiring means. Behavior decrements it every frame and discards the result, so the meaning lives in a state handler that has not been read.
Which of the nine states is the initial one, and the semantic name of any state.

Whether g_profile_SPIDER (0x02122c08) would be emitted by this TU. It is marked `ambiguous` in symbols.txt, the queue's route for this row is text-only so nothing claims it, and the promoted sibling daEyBm_c DOES claim its own g_profile_EYEKUN_BEAM. Not settled here.
The resource ids 0x425 and 0x426 in __sinit_ov071_021226ac's literal pool are read from that pool, not from a decode of the sinit body; what they name is unproven.
